test_Checkpointer_save_load: test the Checkpointer class by saving a PyTorch model checkpoint and loading it into a fresh model
test_PeriodicCheckpointer_step: test the PeriodicCheckpointer step method to verify checkpoints are saved at regular iteration intervals
test_Checkpointer_has_checkpoint: test the Checkpointer has_checkpoint method to check if a checkpoint file exists in the save directory
test_Checkpointer_checkpointables: test the Checkpointer checkpointables parameter to save and load custom objects alongside the model state dict
test_PeriodicCheckpointer_max_to_keep: test the PeriodicCheckpointer max_to_keep parameter to verify only the most recent checkpoints are retained on disk
